name: Château Ollieux Romanis Corbières-Boutenac Cuvée Or 2014
text:
## Château Ollieux Romanis Corbières-Boutenac Cuvée Or 2014

**The story.** Château Ollieux Romanis is near [Boutenac](https://www.google.com/maps?q=Ch%C3%A2teau+Les+Ollieux+Romanis,+Boutenac,+France&t=k) in the [Corbières](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Corbi%C3%A8res_AOC) hills of the Languedoc. The land has been under vine since the 11th century. The Bories family built their own winery and cellar in 1896 from stone quarried on the estate; a century later, Jacqueline and François Bories revived the property but wisely kept the old vines, so the château now has some of the oldest in the region, many 50 to 100 years old. Their son Pierre now runs it ([Wine Access](https://www.wineaccess.com/catalog/2015-chateau-ollieux-corbieres-boutenac-cuvee-or_261ad77d-9330-4dec-97eb-70f6b7400c72)).

**The appellation.** Corbières is the Languedoc's largest appellation, almost all red, with [Carignan](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Carignan) its most common grape. Of its eleven terroirs, Boutenac was the one raised to its own appellation, Corbières-Boutenac, in 2005 ([Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Corbi%C3%A8res_AOC)).

**The wine: Cuvée Or.** "Or" means gold. The Guide Hachette describes the cuvée as coming from very old vines, around 65 years, of Carignan (40%), [Grenache](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Grenache), [Mourvèdre](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mourv%C3%A8dre) and [Syrah](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Syrah), fermented as whole grapes and aged 13 months in barrel, mostly new oak ([Guide Hachette des Vins, 2016 vintage](https://www.hachette-vins.com/guide-vins/les-vins/ollieux-romanis-cuvee-or-2016-2019/201912216/), in French). Wine Access adds that Pierre Bories uses [carbonic maceration](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Carbonic_maceration) for freshness and bottles without fining or filtration ([Wine Access](https://www.wineaccess.com/catalog/2015-chateau-ollieux-corbieres-boutenac-cuvee-or_261ad77d-9330-4dec-97eb-70f6b7400c72)).

**The vintage.** [Jancis Robinson](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jancis_Robinson)'s [Languedoc and Roussillon vintage chart](https://www.jancisrobinson.com/learn/vintages/languedoc-roussillon) says 2014 brought cataclysmic hail storms to the Languedoc, seriously cutting yields; a cool, humid summer delayed the harvest to average dates, and Grenache was exceptionally productive.

**What the critics say for 2014.**
- **[Wine Advocate](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Wine_Advocate): 94**, as quoted by [Wine Access](https://www.wineaccess.com/catalog/2015-chateau-ollieux-corbieres-boutenac-cuvee-or_261ad77d-9330-4dec-97eb-70f6b7400c72): "Hands down the greatest wine I've tasted from this estate." (I couldn't read the full review, only this quote.)
- **[CellarTracker](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/CellarTracker) community: 89.5** (from your CellarTracker list).

**How it's drinking now.** In October 2026 the wine is twelve years old, and your CellarTracker list gives a window of 2017 to 2025. So it is at the end of that window: drink it soon. Expect dark fruit softening into black olive, licorice and garrigue herbs. Decant for about an hour, mainly to leave any sediment behind.

**Food.** Languedoc food: [cassoulet](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cassoulet), duck confit, or lamb with rosemary and garlic.

**Value and where to buy.** The Cuvée Or isn't listed here, but the estate's other wines are cheap and easy to find. BSW Liquor has the Prestige at $28 and the Classique red at $28.99; ZYN has the Prestige 2022 at $30 and the Classique 2022 at $26.70.

**Curious details**
- **Gold for the 2016.** The next Cuvée Or the Guide Hachette reviewed, the 2016, won its "coup de cœur", calling it "a wine at once warm and elegant" ([Guide Hachette des Vins](https://www.hachette-vins.com/guide-vins/les-vins/ollieux-romanis-cuvee-or-2016-2019/201912216/)).
- **Châteauneuf comparisons.** Wine Access notes that the Advocate's praise for the 2015 Cuvée Or, "silky, seamless, powerful and layered", is the kind you'd expect for a Châteauneuf-du-Pape at several times the price ([Wine Access](https://www.wineaccess.com/catalog/2015-chateau-ollieux-corbieres-boutenac-cuvee-or_261ad77d-9330-4dec-97eb-70f6b7400c72)).
